newsitem.title: FRANCE: Kuwait Air ups ex-Paris July rate 3 to 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Air ups ex-Paris July rate 3 to 4 pct.

text.p: Kuwait Airways said it planned to increase its ex-Paris cargo rates by between three and four percent, effective July 1.
The Kuwaiti airline last increased its ex-Paris rates in July 1996.
"Load factors are very good at the moment and the climate is conducive to rate increases as many other carriers are finding," a Paris-based Kuwait Airways cargo official told Reuters.
Kuwait Airways operates a three-times weekly passenger service between Paris and Kuwait City using Airbus 300 and 310s which can carry nine to 12 tonnes of freight per flight.
The airline also runs a weekly Boeing 707F service on a Frankfurt-Paris-Kuwait City routing.
"The aircraft can handle between 35 and 36 tonnes of freight and we share this capacity with our Frankfurt station," the official said.
Kuwait Airways also has an allocation of up to 30 tonnes on a weekly on Air France 747-200F service from CDG to Kuwait City, the official added.
